ARTICLES OF AGREEMENT
Contract title: Design and Build of a Nine-Storey Light Industrial Building at Kranji Loop
SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. All names, places and figures are fictional.
This Agreement is made on 20 May 2026 between Larkspur Industrial Pte Ltd (the Employer) and Ironwood Builders Pte Ltd (the Contractor).
The Site is at 88 Kranji Loop, Singapore 739999.
The Conditions of Contract are the REDAS Design and Build Conditions of Contract.
The Employer's Representative is Mr Benjamin Tay of Larkspur Project Management Pte Ltd.
The Contract Sum is S$38,900,000.00, exclusive of GST at the prevailing rate.

APPENDIX
1. Date of Possession of Site: 1 July 2026
2. Date for Completion of the Works: 30 June 2028
3. Sectional Completion:
Section A (Ramp and Levels 1 to 4): 31 December 2027, liquidated damages S$9,000 per week
Section B (Levels 5 to 9): 30 June 2028, liquidated damages S$12,000 per week
4. Liquidated damages for the Works as a whole: S$21,000 per week
5. Defects Liability Period: 18 months
6. Retention: 5%, up to a maximum of S$1,000,000
7. Performance bond: 10% of the Contract Sum by insurance bond, valid until 6 months after the end of the Defects Liability Period
8. Insurance: contractor's all risks insurance for the Contract Sum; public liability insurance of not less than S$5,000,000 for any one occurrence
9. Nominated subcontractors: facade works (Sunbeam Facades Pte Ltd); lifts (Vertex Lifts Pte Ltd)
10. Interim payment claims: monthly, on the 25th day of each month
11. Days: in this Contract "days" means calendar days, including public holidays
12. Dispute resolution: mediation at the Singapore Mediation Centre first, then arbitration under the SIAC Rules

SC 7. Clause 30.3 is amended: the Employer's Representative shall serve the payment response within 14 days after the payment claim is served.
